name: china-trending-topics
h1: China Trending Topics — Weibo, Douyin, Baidu, Toutiao and Bilibili in One Run
metaTitle: China Trending Topics: Weibo, Douyin, Baidu | ActorForge
metaDescription: Real-time trending topics from Weibo, Douyin, Baidu, Toutiao and Bilibili in one dataset: rank, title, heat score, label and link. $2 per 1,000 topics.
tagline: Five Chinese hot lists, one unified schema: rank, title, heat score, label, category and link for every trending topic, with no login or cookies.
intro: What is trending in China rarely looks the same on every platform. A story can top Weibo's hot search while Douyin is focused on a sports result and Baidu on a consumer scandal. Watching all of them means juggling five Chinese-language sites with different layouts and badges.

This actor captures the live hot lists of **Weibo hot search (微博热搜)**, **Douyin hot list (抖音热榜)**, **Baidu hot search (百度热搜)**, **Toutiao hot board (头条热榜)** and **Bilibili hot words (B站热搜)** in one run, using the platforms' own public hot-list data. Every topic comes back in the same shape regardless of platform: rank, title, heat score, label, category and link. Ads and pinned or government slots are excluded, so `rank` is the organic position.

It is built for China brand monitoring, market research, news and trend detection, social listening and cross-border e-commerce product discovery, and as a real-time context source for AI agents. Topics cost $2 per 1,000, so all five boards at 50 topics each is $0.50 a run.
howItWorks: You choose which boards to capture in `platforms`; the default is all five.
Each board's live public hot list is fetched and normalised into the same row format.
Ads are removed and pinned or government slots on Weibo, Douyin, Baidu and Toutiao are excluded, so ranks are organic.
The optional `keywords` filter keeps only topics whose title or description contains one of your words, and filtered-out topics are not charged.
If one platform is temporarily unavailable, it is skipped and not charged while the other boards are still delivered.
outputNote: Rows from all five boards share the same columns, so you can sort or pivot by platform and rank directly:

useCases.title: Cross-platform trend detection
useCases.text: Run all five boards hourly and look for topics that appear on several lists at once, a stronger signal than a spike on any single platform. Compare by rank rather than raw heat, since each platform scores heat differently.

useCases.title: Brand and competitor alerts
useCases.text: Put brand or product names in `keywords`, in Chinese or English, and schedule frequent runs. You only pay for matching topics, so quiet periods cost almost nothing.

useCases.title: Cross-border e-commerce research
useCases.text: Track which products, events and consumer stories trend in China across news-led boards like Baidu and Toutiao and entertainment-led ones like Douyin and Bilibili.

useCases.title: Live China context for AI agents
useCases.text: Give an agent a current snapshot of what China is talking about, in one call with a consistent schema, before it writes or answers anything China-related.

faq.q: Which Chinese platforms' trending lists are included?
faq.a: Weibo hot search, Douyin hot list, Baidu hot search, Toutiao hot board and Bilibili hot words. You can select any subset with `platforms`.

faq.q: Can I compare heat scores across Weibo, Douyin and Baidu?
faq.a: Not directly. `heatScore` is each platform's own popularity metric, so values are not on the same scale. Compare ranks across platforms and use heat only within one board.

faq.q: How many trending topics does each board return?
faq.a: Each board holds roughly 50 topics at a time. `maxTopicsPerPlatform` defaults to 50 and accepts up to 100, but a value above the board's size simply returns what the board has.

faq.q: Are the trending topics translated into English?
faq.a: No. Titles come back in their original language, mostly Simplified Chinese. Pass them to your own translator or LLM if you need English.

faq.q: How much does hourly monitoring of China trends cost?
faq.a: Topics are $0.002 each. Weibo's top 10 every hour for a month is about 7,200 topics, or $14.40; all five boards at 50 topics in a single run is $0.50.
